Online in Washington

Care without a drive to Woodinville.

We serve eligible Tri-Cities clients online. Our physical office is in Woodinville, Washington; we do not have a Tri-Cities branch office. Telehealth depends on clinician availability, clinical fit, and your physical location at the time of the appointment.

Before opening SimplePractice

In SimplePractice, confirm a clinician and choose the initial clinical evaluation when offered. Choose Telehealth when offered for online individual care.

The link selects the practice; it does not preselect a service, format, or time. If the evaluation or appropriate format is not listed, contact the practice for the next step. Do not choose another service just to reserve a time.

An appointment request is not a confirmed appointment. Keep private clinical information out of ordinary email.

A clear starting point

How to begin online care.

01

Choose a clinician

Read about the clinicians' approaches and confirm which services, age groups, appointment formats, and payment options they currently offer.

02

Choose how to begin

Request an initial clinical evaluation, or choose an optional consultation to discuss fit and the care process. Any applicable consultation fee should be clear before requesting it.

03

Meet online when appropriate

After your appointment is confirmed, follow the practice's instructions for your online visit. Have a private setting and confirm your physical location with your clinician.

An optional conversation first

Choose the start that fits your needs.

Individual care can begin with an initial clinical evaluation. A consultation is optional and is not a therapy session or diagnostic evaluation.

Free 10-minute phone consultation

A brief introduction to discuss fit and the care process. If arranged by video and the technology does not work immediately, this becomes a phone call.

Paid 30-minute individual consultation

More time to discuss fit and questions. Confirm the applicable fee before requesting it; this is separate from the clinical evaluation.

Practical telehealth questions

Know what happens next.

Do I need to travel to Woodinville?

Not for an appointment confirmed as telehealth. Our physical office is in Woodinville; this page describes online care for eligible Washington clients.

Do I need a consultation first?

For individual care, consultations are optional. You can request an initial clinical evaluation directly. A consultation is not a therapy session or diagnostic evaluation.

Can I use insurance?

Coverage and out-of-pocket costs depend on your plan, benefits, service, and clinician. Confirm those details before care. A listed insurance company does not guarantee coverage for every clinician or appointment.

Does clicking the button book an appointment?

No. It opens our appointment-request process in SimplePractice. Your requested appointment must be confirmed.
